theorem slRel_iff_detTriple_of_transporter
    (A B : Fin n × Fin n × Fin n → K) (P Q R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K)
    (hP : IsUnit P.det) (hQ : IsUnit Q.det) (hR : IsUnit R.det)
    (hAB : act P Q R A = B) :
    SLRel A B ↔ (P.det, Q.det, R.det) ∈ DetTriples B := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, V, W, hU, hV, hW, hUVW⟩
    have hUi : IsUnit U.det := by rw [hU]; exact isUnit_one
    have hVi : IsUnit V.det := by rw [hV]; exact isUnit_one
    have hWi : IsUnit W.det := by rw [hW]; exact isUnit_one
    have hi : act U⁻¹ V⁻¹ W⁻¹ B = A := by
      rw [← hUVW, act_inv (unit_matrix hUi) (unit_matrix hVi) (unit_matrix hWi)]
    have dU : (P * U⁻¹).det = P.det := by
      rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, hU, Ring.inverse_one, mul_one]
    have dV : (Q * V⁻¹).det = Q.det := by
      rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, hV, Ring.inverse_one, mul_one]
    have dW : (R * W⁻¹).det = R.det := by
      rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, hW, Ring.inverse_one, mul_one]
    refine ⟨P * U⁻¹, Q * V⁻¹, R * W⁻¹, dU ▸ hP, dV ▸ hQ, dW ▸ hR, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← act_comp, hi, hAB]
    · rw [dU, dV, dW]
  · rintro ⟨U, V, W, hU, hV, hW, hstab, hd⟩
    have hdU : P.det = U.det := congrArg Prod.fst hd
    have hdV : Q.det = V.det := congrArg (fun x : K × K × K => x.2.1) hd
    have hdW : R.det = W.det := congrArg (fun x : K × K × K => x.2.2) hd
    have hi : act U⁻¹ V⁻¹ W⁻¹ B = B := by
      have hh := act_inv (unit_matrix hU) (unit_matrix hV) (unit_matrix hW) B
      rwa [hstab] at hh
    refine ⟨U⁻¹ * P, V⁻¹ * Q, W⁻¹ * R, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw

theorem detTriple_mem_of_three_zero_slices (B : Fin n × Fin n × Fin n → K)
    (i j k : Fin n) (h1 : ∀ b c, B (i, b, c) = 0)
    (h2 : ∀ a c, B (a, j, c) = 0) (h3 : ∀ a b, B (a, b, k) = 0)
    (p q r : K) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    (p, q, r) ∈ DetTriples B := by
  refine ⟨coordinateScale i p, coordinateScale j q, coordinateScale k r,
    by simpa using (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hp),
    by simpa using (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hq),
    by simpa using (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hr), ?_, by simp⟩
  funext x
  rcases x with ⟨a, b, c⟩
  simp only [act, coordinateScale, Matrix.diagonal_apply, ite_mul, zero_mul,
    mul_ite, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  by_cases ha : a = i
  · subst a; simp [h1]
  by_cases hb : b = j
  · subst b; simp [h2]
  by_cases hc : c = k
  · subst c; simp [h3]
  simp [Function.update_of_ne ha, Function.update_of_ne hb, Function.update_of_ne hc]

/-- All three unused coordinates close the orbit obstruction over EVERY field. -/
theorem slRel_iff_glRel_of_three_zero_slices
    (A B : Fin n × Fin n × Fin n → K) (i j k : Fin n)
    (h1 : ∀ b c, B (i, b, c) = 0) (h2 : ∀ a c, B (a, j, c) = 0)
    (h3 : ∀ a b, B (a, b, k) = 0) : SLRel A B ↔ GLRel A B := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, Q, R, hP, hQ, hR, hact⟩
    exact ⟨P, Q, R, hP ▸ isUnit_one, hQ ▸ isUnit_one, hR ▸ isUnit_one, hact⟩
  · rintro ⟨P, Q, R, hP, hQ, hR, hact⟩
    apply (slRel_iff_detTriple_of_transporter A B P Q R hP hQ hR hact).2
    exact detTriple_mem_of_three_zero_slices B i j k h1 h2 h3
      _ _ _ hP.ne_zero hQ.ne_zero hR.ne_zero

theorem fixed_lift_iff (χ : H →* D) (F : H →* H) (h : H) :
    (∃ x, χ x = χ h ∧ F x = x) ↔
    (∃ n, χ n = 1 ∧ obstruction F h = n * (F n)⁻¹) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,hx,hF⟩
    refine ⟨h⁻¹*x,by simp [hx],?_⟩
    simp only [obstruction,map_mul,map_inv,hF,mul_inv_rev]
    group
  · rintro ⟨n,hn,hc⟩
    refine ⟨h*n,by simp [hn],?_⟩
    have he : F h = h * (n * (F n)⁻¹) := by
      rw [← hc,obstruction]
      group
    rw [map_mul,he]
    group

theorem fixed_lift_of_component_correction (χ : H →* D) (F : H →* H)
    (J : Subgroup H) (h : H)
    (langJ : ∀ c ∈ J, ∃ a ∈ J, c = a*(F a)⁻¹)
    (hJ : ∀ a ∈ J, χ a = 1)
    (component : ∃ b, χ b = 1 ∧ b⁻¹ * obstruction F h * F b ∈ J) :
    ∃ x, χ x = χ h ∧ F x = x := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hc⟩ := component
  rw [← change_lift] at hc
  obtain ⟨a,ha,he⟩ := langJ _ hc
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hfix⟩ := (fixed_lift_iff χ F (h*b)).mpr ⟨a,hJ a ha,he⟩
  exact ⟨x,by simpa [hb] using hx,hfix⟩

def fixedFibreEquiv (χ : H →* D) (F : H →* H) (h : H) (hh : F h = h) :
    {n : H // χ n = 1 ∧ F n = n} ≃ {x : H // χ x = χ h ∧ F x = x} where
  toFun n := ⟨h*n,by simp [n.property.1],by simp [hh,n.property.2]⟩
  invFun x := ⟨h⁻¹*x,by simp [x.property.1],by simp [hh,x.property.2]⟩
  left_inv n := by apply Subtype.ext; simp
  right_inv x := by apply Subtype.ext; simp

theorem simultaneous_power_fiber {G : Type*} [CommGroup G]
    (a b : G) (d M N r s : ℤ) (hbez : M * r + N * s = 1) :
    (∃ t : G, t ^ (d * M) = a ∧ t ^ (d * N) = b) ↔
      a ^ N = b ^ M ∧ ∃ t : G, t ^ d = a ^ r * b ^ s := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ha, hb⟩
    constructor
    · rw [← ha, ← hb, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul]
      congr 1
      ring
    · refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
      rw [← ha, ← hb, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_add]
      congr 1
      calc
        d = d * 1 := by ring
        _ = d * (M * r + N * s) := by rw [hbez]
        _ = d * M * r + d * N * s := by ring
  · rintro ⟨hc, t, ht⟩
    have hA : (a ^ r * b ^ s) ^ M = a := by
      rw [mul_zpow, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul]
      have hb : b ^ (s * M) = a ^ (N * s) := by
        rw [mul_comm s M, zpow_mul, ← hc, ← zpow_mul]
      rw [hb, ← zpow_add]
      have he : r * M + N * s = 1 := by simpa only [mul_comm r M] using hbez
      rw [he, zpow_one]
    have hB : (a ^ r * b ^ s) ^ N = b := by
      rw [mul_zpow, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul]
      have ha : a ^ (r * N) = b ^ (M * r) := by
        rw [mul_comm r N, zpow_mul, hc, ← zpow_mul]
      rw [ha, ← zpow_add]
      have he : M * r + s * N = 1 := by simpa only [mul_comm s N] using hbez
      rw [he, zpow_one]
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [zpow_mul, ht]
      exact hA
    · rw [zpow_mul, ht]
      exact hB

theorem bezout_power_root {G : Type*} [Group G] (x : G)
    (m n u v : ℤ) (hbez : m * u + n * v = 1) (hx : x ^ n = 1) :
    (x ^ u) ^ m = x := by
  have he : x ^ (m * u + n * v) = x := by
    rw [hbez]
    simp
  rw [zpow_add, zpow_mul x n v, hx, one_zpow, mul_one] at he
  simpa only [← zpow_mul, mul_comm u m] using he

theorem three_character_kernels (S : Subgroup D3) :
    ∃ f g h : D3 →* Kˣ, ∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ f x = 1 ∧ g x = 1 ∧ h x = 1 := by
  letI := enough_roots (K := K)
  let e := (CommGroup.monoidHom_mulEquiv_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity D3 K).some
  let H := annihilator S
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,ha,hb,hc,_,_,_,hn⟩ := triangular_generators (H.map e.toMonoidHom)
  obtain ⟨f,hf,ef⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨g,hg,eg⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨h,hh,eh⟩ := hc
  change e f = a at ef
  change e g = b at eg
  change e h = c at eh
  refine ⟨f,g,h,?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨hf x hx,hg x hx,hh x hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨hfx,hgx,hhx⟩
    apply (CommGroup.forall_monoidHom_apply_eq_one_iff K S x).1
    intro chi hchi
    have hm : e chi ∈ H.map e.toMonoidHom := ⟨chi,hchi,rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i,j,k,hk⟩ := (hn (e chi)).1 hm
    have he : chi = f^i*g^j*h^k := by
      apply e.injective
      simpa only [map_mul,map_zpow,ef,eg,eh] using hk
    rw [he]
    simp [hfx,hgx,hhx]

theorem character_is_monomial (chi : (U × U × U) →* U) :
    ∃ r s t : ℤ, ∀ x, chi x = x.1^r*x.2.1^s*x.2.2^t := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := (chi.comp axis1).map_cyclic
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := (chi.comp axis2).map_cyclic
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := (chi.comp axis3).map_cyclic
  refine ⟨r,s,t,?_⟩
  intro x
  have he : x = axis1 x.1 * axis2 x.2.1 * axis3 x.2.2 := by simp [axis1,axis2,axis3]
  calc
    chi x = chi (axis1 x.1 * axis2 x.2.1 * axis3 x.2.2) := congrArg chi he
    _ = x.1^r*x.2.1^s*x.2.2^t := by
      rw [map_mul,map_mul]
      exact congrArg₂ (· * ·) (congrArg₂ (· * ·) (hr x.1) (hs x.2.1)) (ht x.2.2)

theorem universal_bounded_equations {n : ℕ} (A : Fin n × Fin n × Fin n → K) :
    ∃ E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℤ,
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ E i j ∧ E i j < (Fintype.card K - 1 : ℕ)) ∧
      ∀ d : D3, d ∈ detTriplesSubgroup A ↔
        ∀ i : Fin 3, d.1^(E i 0)*d.2.1^(E i 1)*d.2.2^(E i 2) = 1 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨E,hE⟩ := universal_three_equations A
  have hq : (0 : ℤ) < (Fintype.card K - 1 : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Fintype.card K - 1 by
      rw [← Fintype.card_units]; exact Fintype.card_pos)
  have hpow (u : Kˣ) (z : ℤ) : u^(z % (Fintype.card K - 1 : ℕ)) = u^z := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_units] using zpow_mod_card u z
  refine ⟨fun i j => E i j % (Fintype.card K - 1 : ℕ),?_,?_⟩
  · intro i j
    exact ⟨Int.emod_nonneg _ (ne_of_gt hq),Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hq⟩
  · intro d
    simpa only [hpow] using hE d

theorem intertwiner_mul {a b : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) K × Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l) K}
    (ha : a ∈ Intertwiner U) (hb : b ∈ Intertwiner U) :
    ((a.1 * b.1, a.2 * b.2) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) K × Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l) K)
      ∈ Intertwiner U := by
  intro M hM
  have h : a.1 * (b.1 * M) = a.1 * (M * b.2) := by rw [hb M hM]
  calc a.1 * b.1 * M = a.1 * (b.1 * M) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = a.1 * (M * b.2) := h
    _ = (a.1 * M) * b.2 := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (M * a.2) * b.2 := by rw [ha M hM]
    _ = M * (a.2 * b.2) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]

theorem intertwiner_inv {a : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) K × Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l) K}
    (ha : a ∈ Intertwiner U) (hQ : IsUnit a.1.det) (hR : IsUnit a.2.det) :
    ((a.1⁻¹, a.2⁻¹) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) K × Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l) K) ∈ Intertwiner U := by
  intro M hM
  have hinvQ : a.1⁻¹ * a.1 = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hQ
  have hinvR : a.2 * a.2⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hR
  calc a.1⁻¹ * M = a.1⁻¹ * (M * (a.2 * a.2⁻¹)) := by rw [hinvR, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = a.1⁻¹ * ((M * a.2) * a.2⁻¹) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = a.1⁻¹ * ((a.1 * M) * a.2⁻¹) := by rw [ha M hM]
    _ = (a.1⁻¹ * a.1) * (M * a.2⁻¹) := by
          rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = M * a.2⁻¹ := by rw [hinvQ, Matrix.one_mul]

    norm R x ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0 := not_iff_not.mpr norm_eq_zero_iff

/-- This is `Algebra.norm_eq_zero_iff` composed with `Algebra.norm_apply`. -/
@[simp]
theorem norm_eq_zero_iff' [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S] [Module.Free R S] [Module.Finite R S] {x : S} :
    LinearMap.det (LinearMap.mul R S x) = 0 ↔ x = 0 := norm_eq_zero_iff

theorem norm_eq_zero_iff_of_basis [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S] (b : Basis ι R S) {x : S} :
    Algebra.norm R x = 0 ↔ x = 0 := by
  have : Module.Free R S := Module.Free.of_basis b
  have : Module.Finite R S := Module.Finite.of_basis b
  exact norm_eq_zero_iff

theorem norm_ne_zero_iff_of_basis [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S] (b : Basis ι R S) {x : S} :
    Algebra.norm R x ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0 :=
  not_iff_not.mpr (norm_eq_zero_iff_of_basis b)

theorem average_identity (F : N →* N) (c : N) (r : ℕ) :
    averageProduct F c r * (F (averageProduct F c r))⁻¹ =
      c^r * (twistedNorm F c r)⁻¹ := by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp [averageProduct, twistedNorm]
  | succ r ih =>
    have hi := congrArg F ih
    simp only [map_mul, map_inv, map_pow] at hi
    simp only [averageProduct, map_mul, map_pow, mul_inv_rev, twistedNorm, pow_succ]
    rw [show c^r * F (averageProduct F c r) *
        ((F (F (averageProduct F c r)))⁻¹ * (F c^r)⁻¹) =
        c^r * (F (averageProduct F c r) * (F (F (averageProduct F c r)))⁻¹) * (F c^r)⁻¹ by simp only [mul_assoc]]
    rw [hi]
    simp [mul_assoc, mul_comm]
    group

theorem correction_of_coprime_order (F : N →* N) (c : N) (r : ℕ)
    (hnorm : twistedNorm F c r = 1) (hcop : r.Coprime (orderOf c)) :
    ∃ n, c = n * (F n)⁻¹ := by
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := exists_pow_eq_self_of_coprime hcop
  exact ⟨averageProduct F c r ^ k, explicit_correction F c r k hnorm hk⟩
